name: Jiangsu Lopal Tech. Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Lopal Tech. Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of lithium iron phosphate cathode materials and environmental protection fine chemicals for vehicles in China and internationally. It operates through sales of LFP cathode materials, sales of automotive fine chemicals, and processing of lithium carbonate and raw materials. The company provides automotive lubricants, grease, coolants, brake fluids, chemicals, industrial lubricating grease, automotive maintenance products, lithium battery materials, hydrogen energy, biotechnology, and plastic new materials.
